intent: I increased the number of sensors to 5, arranged symmetrically and slightly forward, to improve line detection and reduce line loss events. I chose a medium sensor size (0.012) to balance resolution and noise robustness. The body size and wheel track are moderate to provide stability and maneuverability. I expect better line following accuracy and fewer stalls or line losses, improving progress and completion rates.
rationale: Starting from no prior geometry, I selected a moderate body size (0.18m length, 0.14m width) and mass (0.9kg) to balance stability and agility. The wheel radius (0.035m) and track (0.14m) are chosen to provide good turning capability without sacrificing speed. The sensor array is expanded to 5 sensors spaced evenly across the front, slightly forward (y positive) to detect the line early and symmetrically to detect line position accurately. The sensor size 0.012 is a middle ground to reduce noise while maintaining resolution. This setup should reduce line loss events and rms error by improving line detection and control input quality. I request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, and line_loss_events to verify these hypotheses in the next race.
